scope: warm-state repeat of a previously successful step20 control image, to separate device state from image content
hypothesis_tested: the two 75s timeouts on 2026-10-24 were caused by residual device state after manual recovery
warm_state_definition: device had been running Android since the 16:23:08 manual recovery for about 14 minutes, with no power cycle; the failed stage23-control run at 16:20:56 started about 14 minutes after the 16:06:02 recovery, so the two preconditions are equivalent
excluded_causes: device residual state after manual recovery (this test)
display probe algorithm content (three successes on the same step20/query1 predicate)
CONFIGURED delay and wait bounds (the same image succeeded twice, and no new wait exists in step20)

remaining_candidates.detail: EnumaStageCheckpoint calls MicroSecondDelay then ResetCold (PSCI SYSTEM_RESET) then CpuDeadLoop; if PSCI neither returns nor resets, the image never returns and the screen stays dark with no USB enumeration

remaining_candidates.candidate: display MMIO read hang inside SimpleFbDxe
remaining_candidates.detail: the probe reads 0x0ae00000..0x0ae84207; an unmapped or unpowered MDP window would raise an unhandled exception or stall before StartImage returns, so no status is ever reported

discriminating_test: a candidate that performs no display MMIO read and no wait, stopped at an earlier Core point, repeated over several trials to measure the failure rate; if it never stalls the MMIO read is implicated, if it stalls at a similar rate the exit path is implicated
interpretation: 同源step20/query1共4笔实机,3成功1超时;热状态重跑曾成功镜像成功,故超时不能归因恢复后残留状态,也不能归因step20代码路径。超时与镜像内容相关性下降,偶发出口失败成为主嫌疑,但尚无可采集日志能区分复位出口与MMIO读挂死。
